label_en: Labour rights apply whatever a worker’s immigration status
label_id: Hak pekerja berlaku apa pun status imigrasinya

label_en: Treating migrant workers worse than others breaches equality
label_id: Memperlakukan pekerja migran lebih buruk melanggar kesetaraan

label_en: Tying a worker to one employer breaches liberty or freedom of occupation
label_id: Mengikat pekerja pada satu majikan melanggar kebebasan

label_en: The state must make forced labour and servitude crimes and enforce them
label_id: Negara wajib menjadikan kerja paksa dan perhambaan tindak pidana dan menegakkannya

label_en: The state must investigate trafficking and protect possible victims
label_id: Negara wajib menyelidiki perdagangan orang dan melindungi calon korban

label_en: Illegal working does not bar a claim against an abusive employer
label_id: Bekerja secara ilegal tidak menghalangi gugatan terhadap majikan yang menyalahgunakan

label_en: The recruiter at home is liable together with the employer abroad
label_id: Agen perekrut di dalam negeri ikut bertanggung jawab bersama majikan di luar negeri

label_en: A rule struck down as unconstitutional cannot simply be re-enacted
label_id: Aturan yang sudah dibatalkan tidak bisa begitu saja dibuat lagi

label_en: Protection laws must keep covering seafarers and fishers
label_id: UU pelindungan harus tetap mencakup awak kapal dan pelaut perikanan

label_en: The state must secure food and registration for migrant workers in a crisis
label_id: Negara wajib menjamin pangan dan pendataan pekerja migran saat krisis

label_en: A compulsory live-in rule is unlawful
label_id: Aturan wajib tinggal bersama majikan tidak sah

label_en: Discrimination because of immigration status is race or nationality discrimination
label_id: Diskriminasi karena status imigrasi adalah diskriminasi ras atau kewarganegaraan

label_en: Arrested foreign nationals must be told they can contact their consulate
label_id: Warga asing yang ditangkap wajib diberi tahu hak menghubungi konsulat

label_en: Irregular entry or stay must not be punished with prison
label_id: Masuk atau tinggal tanpa dokumen tidak boleh dihukum penjara

label_en: Migrants may not be expelled as a group without individual review
label_id: Migran tidak boleh diusir berkelompok tanpa pemeriksaan perorangan

label_en: Children born in the country must not be left stateless because of their parents’ status
label_id: Anak yang lahir di negara itu tidak boleh dibiarkan tanpa kewarganegaraan karena status orang tuanya

label_en: Migrants are entitled at least to emergency health care
label_id: Migran berhak setidaknya atas layanan kesehatan darurat

label_en: Restricting women’s migration breaches equality
label_id: Membatasi migrasi perempuan melanggar kesetaraan

label_en: Accusations made after a dispute with the employer must be examined for motive
label_id: Tuduhan yang muncul setelah sengketa dengan majikan harus diperiksa motifnya

label_en: Immigration detention must have a time limit and prompt review by a court
label_id: Penahanan imigrasi harus punya batas waktu dan segera ditinjau pengadilan

label_en: A worker’s lawful speech or activism must not cost them their stay or freedom
label_id: Pendapat atau kegiatan sah pekerja tidak boleh membuatnya kehilangan izin tinggal atau kebebasan

label_en: People waiting for protection decisions have a right to work
label_id: Orang yang menunggu keputusan perlindungan berhak bekerja

label_en: Migrant parents may stay to care for children who are residents
label_id: Orang tua migran boleh tinggal untuk merawat anak yang berstatus penduduk

label_en: Pregnancy or childbirth must not cost a migrant worker her job or permit
label_id: Kehamilan atau persalinan tidak boleh membuat pekerja migran kehilangan pekerjaan atau izin

label_en: Working-time limits and overtime apply to live-in care work
label_id: Batas jam kerja dan lembur berlaku bagi pekerja perawatan yang tinggal di rumah majikan

label_en: Wages may not be withheld to push workers to leave
label_id: Upah tidak boleh ditahan untuk mendorong pekerja pergi

label_en: The state may set minimum terms for domestic workers’ contracts
label_id: Negara boleh menetapkan syarat minimum kontrak pekerja rumah tangga

label_en: Fundamental rights protect non-citizens, not only citizens
label_id: Hak dasar melindungi bukan warga negara, tidak hanya warga negara

label_en: No one may be sent back to a place where they face serious harm
label_id: Tidak seorang pun boleh dipulangkan ke tempat ia menghadapi bahaya serius

label_en: Excluding domestic workers from labour protection is discrimination
label_id: Mengecualikan pekerja rumah tangga dari perlindungan kerja adalah diskriminasi

label_en: Random migration checks breach freedom of movement and lead to profiling
label_id: Pemeriksaan imigrasi acak melanggar kebebasan bergerak dan memicu profil rasial

label_en: The state must prove that a person is a foreigner before treating them as one
label_id: Negara wajib membuktikan seseorang orang asing sebelum memperlakukannya demikian

label_en: Trafficked people must not be punished for offences they were forced to commit
label_id: Korban perdagangan orang tidak boleh dihukum atas pelanggaran yang dipaksakan kepada mereka

label_en: Migrant workers abroad keep the right to vote at home
label_id: Pekerja migran di luar negeri tetap berhak memilih di negaranya
